native_validation.claim: This source audit records no native final-module pass. Release gameplay/fuel results must identify the exact final source/module hash. Earlier versions and repaired failures remain development evidence with their own provenance.

fuel_bounds: Current remembered-origin cache keys are shared across horizon checks; native walking regions are cached per actor/horizon/snapshot.

Exact hidden origin expansion is optional only at uncertainty extent<=2 with reserve+50000 fuel; larger cases retain a conservative scalar threat. Walking blockers/packed terrain are cached; no per-neighbor public host lookup is used.
Low-fuel missing-threat and channel checks widen to a conservative scalar/geometric risk; budget exhaustion never silently erases a possible recent enemy.

The gameplay planning loop requires reserve+30000 fuel. After accepted world-changing actions a full refresh requires reserve+44000, otherwise the owner turn stops without another decision. Same-epoch self-only refresh is limited to own transactions/self casts.
The channel-cancel alternative loop stops below reserve+18000 fuel; stopping that search does not by itself cancel a channel or certify an escape.

Coordinator phases require reserve+26000 before falling through to additional combat/recovery/farm planning. Idle/hold-only ward search requires 45000 fuel, scores at most four legal anchors and has its own floor.

Current visible actor/camp refresh uses official SDK 2.2.2 imported bulk records with host personal-visibility guards; actual move speed comes from the fresh record. The adapter is explicitly pinned and must be reviewed on SDK upgrade.

The action gateway rechecks epoch and at least 12000 actual fuel after legality queries before each mutation expression. Dash path eligibility requires 24000 actual fuel separately. Attempt bookkeeping follows the final gate; a stale return does not advertise a successful attempt.
Ward candidate search, actor state/metadata reads and route caches are bounded. These source facts require the final gameplay fuel profile; they are not a no-exhaustion guarantee.
